title: Multiple Routes
prompt:
Create an Express server with multiple route handlers for a simple API.

**Requirements:**
1. Import `express` and create an app instance
2. Enable JSON body parsing with `express.json()`
3. Add a GET route at `/api/items` that returns all items
4. Add a POST route at `/api/items` that adds a new item
5. Export the app as the default export
hints: You need both app.get() and app.post() on the same path
Use an array to store items in memory
Set status 201 for created resources: res.status(201).json(item)

app.js.hint: Enable JSON body parsing with app.use(express.json())

app.js.description: Set HTTP status code on response
